notes.title: 🛠 A small but important update! 🛠
notes.notes:
Friends, we continue to work on improving the game, and today we are releasing a small but significant patch! In this update we:

Fixed a few bugs that you actively报告 helped us with - thanks for your help!

Fixed the cut-scenes to make them smoother and more immersive.

Your feedback and bug reports are incredibly important to us. If you notice something weird or have suggestions, write us - we read everything and continue to improve the game!

Thank you for your support and patience. There's a lot more fun stuff to come! 🚀

notes.title: 🚀 A grand update is on the horizon! 🚀
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we are happy to share some important news with you! Very soon you will get access to a huge update that we have been working on day and night. It's not just another patch - it's a real step forward, which was made possible thanks to your support and criticism. Thank you for always being with us and helping us get better! 🙏

What's in store for you in this update?
We've prepared a demo for you that will show you the direction we're heading in. It's just the beginning of a big journey, but it's already filled with the new features, fixes and improvements you've been waiting for. We've taken your feedback into account, reworked many aspects and tried to do everything we can to make you feel the game getting better every day.

What's next?
After the release of this update, we will start working on the second and subsequent chapters. It will be even more extensive, exciting and detailed. But to make it go smoothly, we need your help!

🐞 Your feedback and bug reports are our everything!
If while testing the demo you notice any bugs, errors or just want to share your impressions - write us! Your messages will help us to make the game even better, more stable and more interesting. We read every message and take into account all your wishes.

Keep an eye on the news!
Soon we will reveal all the details of the update and tell you how you can try the demo version. Stay tuned for more cool changes, surprises and, of course, your support!

Thank you for being with us. Together we will make this project truly outstanding! 🚀

Regards,
Enunion Team.

notes.title: THE GAME NOW HAS ACHIEVEMENTS!
notes.notes:
🎉 There are now achievements in Everyday Life Fragments! 🎮

Now your immersion into the distorted reality has become even deeper - we've added an achievement system that will reveal hidden plot details and reward the most attentive explorers.

🔍 What's in store for you?

Story achievements that will unlock as you progress through the chapters.

Each unlocked Achievement is a new part of the story hidden between fragments of everyday life. Will you be able to unlock all the secrets?

🚪 Are you ready to look beyond reality?

notes.title: DEMO VERSION OF THE GAME IS ALREADY AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that the first demo version of our game Everyday Life Fragments is out and already available for everyone! 🕵️‍♂️ Immerse yourself in a strange and distorted reality, where familiar everyday life turns into a mystery, and the line between dream and reality becomes blurred.

🚪 What awaits you in the demo:

An atmospheric first chapter, revealing the beginning of a mysterious story.

A dive into the mind of Artyom - a man whose reality is slowly crumbling.

Mysteries and subtle hints that reveal the essence of what is happening.

✨ What's next?
We are actively working on the next chapters, where you will be waiting for more mysticism, unexpected plot twists and deep exploration of the dark corners of the mind. New locations, puzzles, and answers to the questions the demo will leave behind are ahead.

💬 Your support is important! Share your impressions, leave feedback - they help us to make the game better.

🎮 Try the demo now!
👉 Go to Steam and download the demo

Thank you for being a part of this story - the fun is just beginning!
